name: virtuoso-marketplace
description: Marketplace hosting the Virtuoso governance & dispatch plugin.

plugins.name: virtuoso
plugins.description: Provider-based governance & dispatch suite: roadmap planning, execution discipline, close-outs, mid-dispatch decisions, audits, and doc hygiene, joined into a learning loop in which every close-out records its lessons and every new specification is checked against them — driven by a per-project registry that declares its live work register, terminal ledger, ownership rules, and permitted mutations.
